text: Please I am so sorry to disturb you this night. I am a childminder and I am watching a baby girl, she is just one month old. Her temperature is 40, I checked it two times. She is not herself at all, she is very sleepy and soft like her body has no strength, when I try to wake her she is not waking well, not responding the way she normally does. There is no rash anywhere on her body, I checked everywhere. I have called her mother but she is not picking. Please what do I do, I am sorry
